FastAPI validates the parsed request body through `ModelField.validate`; Pydantic v2 compiles model validators and discriminated unions into the core schema, with `before` model validators wrapping the inner model schema. Removing the discriminator before tagged-union validation changes or prevents variant selection; any optional/defaulted union field can then materialize as its default (`None`) without a FastAPI 422.

Relevant files:

- [sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0:fastapi/routing.py?L196-L285](/r/github.com/sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0/-/blob/fastapi/routing.py?L196-L285) - Route handler reads JSON and calls `solve_dependencies`; the solved values are passed to the endpoint.
- [sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0:fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L522-L647](/r/github.com/sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0/-/blob/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L522-L647) - `solve_dependencies()` resolves path/query/header/cookie parameters, then delegates body parameters to `request_body_to_args()`.
- [sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0:fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L685-L764](/r/github.com/sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0/-/blob/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L685-L764) - `request_body_to_args()` extracts each body value and calls `field.validate(value, values, loc=loc)`, which invokes the Pydantic-backed field validator and assigns the validated model to `values[field.name]`.
- [sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0:fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L767-L810](/r/github.com/sg-evals/fastapi--0.110.0/-/blob/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py?L767-L810) - `get_body_field()` preserves a single Pydantic body parameter or creates an aggregate `BodyModel` for multiple body parameters.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/main.py?L513-L538](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/main.py?L513-L538) - `BaseModel.model_validate_json()` delegates to `__pydantic_validator__.validate_json(...)`; the equivalent Python-object path is `model_validate()` at lines 500–511.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L2018-L2062](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L2018-L2062) - `apply_model_validators()` wraps the core schema. `mode='inner'` applies only `before` validators, using `core_schema.*_before_validator_function`, so the preprocessor runs before normal field/union validation.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L1061-L1074](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L1061-L1074) - Field schema generation applies `Field(discriminator=...)` through `_apply_discriminator_to_union()`.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L402-L418](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py?L402-L418) - `_apply_discriminator_to_union()` converts the union using `_discriminated_union.apply_discriminator()`.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py?L38-L95](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py?L38-L95) - `apply_discriminators()` and `apply_discriminator()` transform the union into a tagged union.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py?L98-L116](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/_internal/_discriminated_union.py?L98-L116) - `_ApplyInferredDiscriminator` documents and initializes discriminator-key inference and tagged-choice construction.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:docs/errors/usage_errors.md?L296-L301](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/docs/errors/usage_errors.md?L296-L301) - Pydantic explicitly forbids `before`, `wrap`, or `plain` validators directly on the discriminator field because changing it affects model-type selection.
- [sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4:pydantic/functional_validators.py?L530-L590](/r/github.com/sg-evals/pydantic--v2.6.4/-/blob/pydantic/functional_validators.py?L530-L590) - Public `model_validator(mode='before')` declaration and semantics.
